description: Manually fire a workflow trigger to start a new run immediately, bypassing any schedule or event condition. For Standard SKU, workflowName is required. Use get_workflow_triggers first to find available trigger names. Then use list_run_history to see the result.

triggerName.description: The name of the trigger to run (e.g., 'manual', 'When_a_HTTP_request_is_received')
